items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And he just used to keep me working all the time. And I became one of his favorite trumpet players... And Dave Klein he's the one that -- and I made the soundtrack for a lot of the movies

ctx.x: So it came more, then, from the guys in the band?

In the band, yes. And Manny had a brother at the time, Dave Klein, who was a contractor here in Los Angeles. And he was an ex-trumpet player. And he just used to keep me working all the time. And I became one of his favorite trumpet players, you know.
Well, you fell on your feet very nicely.
